The Verdict and the Watch List

The position is unchanged in method and upgraded in signal. The base case anchors on the $134 billion completed mark until the Coatue round settles; the $188 billion term sheet is treated as the market's confirmed forward bid on an engine whose last four prints accelerated from +50% to +80% at $7 billion scale. On close, the mark is adopted, the run-rate multiple moves to 27.2x on the June print, and the appraisal re-runs with the new equity in the denominator. Nothing in the announcement weakens the quality thesis; the announcement exists because of it.

Three dated numbers decide the next quarter of this coverage. First, the close: the company expects funds later this summer, and a completed deal record is the adoption event (company announcement, July 17, 2026). Second, the September to October print: gross margin against the 70% efficiency gate with a four-point cushion, the run-rate against the $6.9 billion June level, and the scheduled refresh of the February operating metrics. Third, the registry: any S-1 at the company's filing index re-rates the listing window immediately (last verified clean, SEC EDGAR, July 10, 2026).

The falsifier is unchanged and singular: a gross-margin print below 70% breaks the efficiency gate and forces a re-score of the quality thesis regardless of what the round does. Everything else in this note is a re-rate of price against a business whose published trajectory is still accelerating; that one number is the only print that would change what the business is.
